[ 00 — The premise ]

We treat code as a material — something with grain and resistance, something you sculpt rather than command. A noise function is our clay; a random seed is our chisel. We build systems that make their own decisions, then we tune the rules until the machine surprises us. The result is never a single image. It is a space of images — a living thing that keeps drawing itself long after we have left the room.

03 / Capabilities

What we make

01

Live installations

Real-time, sensor-and-data-driven artworks for galleries, lobbies, and public space — built to run unattended for years.

02

Generative identity

Brand systems that aren't a single logo but an entire grammar — infinite, on-brand variations from one parametric source.

03

Data sculpture

Turning datasets into objects and prints — pen-plotter editions, CNC reliefs, and 3D-printed forms grown from numbers.

04

Web experiences

Performant canvas and WebGL work for the browser — launch sites, generative drops, and interactive editorial.

05

Workshops & R&D

Teaching teams to think in systems — from intro creative-coding sessions to embedded research residencies.

06

Tooling & libraries

We open-source the engines we build — small, dependency-free libraries for noise, color, and plotter output.
